messages:
Marta (CS): Quick check-in for BlueNorth — weekly account health (2026-03-14 → 2026-03-20). Notable: error-rate up, timeouts concentrated, a handful of rate-limit spikes. TL;DR below.

Leo (SRE): Thanks. Can you paste the top failing URIs and breakout by class?

Marta (CS): Sure — short summary first: overall 5xx = 1.9% (was 0.4%), client timeouts = 2.6% (was 0.9%), rate-limited requests = 3.1% (was 1.2%). Most failures concentrated on two routes.

Anika (AE): Renewal touchpoint next Wed — flagging this as a potential risk if latency/cost spike persists. Need a mitigation note to share with the customer.

Marta (CS): Top failing endpoints (by failure count):
1) /v1/chat/completions — 52% of failures (mix of 5xx + client timeouts).
2) /v1/embeddings — 23% (timeouts + occasional 504 from upstream).
3) /v1/generate?mode=stream — 12% (intermittent broken streams causing client disconnects).
4) /v1/rerank — 6% (rate limit bursts from batch jobs).
5) /health/ping (internal) — 7% (mostly probe timeouts during infra autoscale).

Devon (Eng): Do we have recent deploys that could explain 5xx bump?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: service/redwood-runtime v3.14.2 deployed to prod-blue-north at 2026-03-16T02:11Z — no automated rollback triggered.

Leo (SRE): Correlating: the 5xx spike aligns with the post-deploy window + a spike in long-tail sequence lengths on /v1/chat/completions (lots of >2048 tokens). Memory pressure + KV cache thrash triggered OOM retries — those show up as 5xx.

Marta (CS): Customer usage note: BlueNorth enabled streaming for a big internal experiment on 3/16 and also launched a nightly batch that calls embeddings in bulk between 01:00–03:00 UTC. That accounts for the rate-limit bursts.

Anika (AE): Action items I need to share in renewal prep doc: what can we promise quickly to show progress?

Devon (Eng): Short-term mitigations: 1) Temporarily cap streaming concurrency for BlueNorth to 6 sessions. 2) Add prefix caching for the most common chat prompts. 3) Adjust rate-limit policy to allow scheduled batch windows for their account (burst allowance). I can implement 1+3 today as config flags.

Leo (SRE): Operational follow-ups: rotate runtime to v3.14.1 on the affected pool to test revert, add a KV-cache hit-rate dashboard tile, and create an alert for chat tail-latency > 2.5s P95.

Marta (CS): Customer-facing message draft (short): "We saw an increase in errors/timeouts tied to a platform deploy and high-volume experiments on your side. We've throttled streaming concurrency and scheduled a burst window for your nightly embeds; we expect error-rate to fall within 24 hours. Eng and SRE are monitoring and will follow up with a post-mortem." Thoughts?

Anika (AE): Good. Add estimated ETA: 6–12 hours for visible improvement, and a deeper write-up by EOD tomorrow. I'll put this in the renewal brief.

Devon (Eng): Will toggle concurrency cap now and open PR for the scheduled rate policy change. Link to PR once created.

Marta (CS): Nice — I'll ping BlueNorth CSM and include the short message + planned ETA. Will update thread with monitoring screenshots once available. :thumbsup:

Leo (SRE): One more note — embeddings timeouts are mostly 504s from an upstream redis cluster during autoscale. Ops will look at provisioned memory and eviction rates.

Marta (CS): Cool. Follow-ups:
- Devon: implement caps + rate-window (owner)
- Leo: KV cache dashboard + embedding infra check (owner)
- Anika: renewal brief + customer comms (owner)
- Marta: monitor and update thread with graphs

Marta (CS): Closing for now — will reopen if error-rate doesn't trend down by tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
